title: PDF tables and invoices to rows

urls.title: PDF URLs
urls.description: Links to PDF files: invoices, bills, purchase orders, price lists, statistical tables, reports. Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive/SharePoint, Box and GitHub share links are converted to direct downloads (share them as 'Anyone with the link').

kvStoreFileNames.title: …or PDFs in a key-value store
kvStoreFileNames.description: Names of PDF files uploaded to an Apify key-value store. Use 'storeIdOrName/fileName', or just 'fileName' together with the store below (default: this run's store).

kvStoreId.title: Key-value store ID or name
kvStoreId.description: Store that holds the files above.

datasetId.title: …or dataset with PDF URLs
datasetId.description: Apify dataset (for example the output of a crawler) whose items contain PDF URLs.

datasetUrlField.title: Dataset URL field
datasetUrlField.description: Field of the dataset items that holds the PDF URL.

mode.title: What to extract
enumTitles: Auto: invoices as line items, other PDFs as table rows
Invoices: one row per line item, with supplier, number, dates, VAT and totals
Tables: one row per table row, for any PDF
mode.description: Auto treats a PDF as an invoice when page 1 says invoice / bill to / factura / Rechnung / facture and an item table or invoice fields are found; otherwise every table becomes rows.

tableDetection.title: Table detection
enumTitles: Auto: tables with borders, then tables without borders
Only tables drawn with borders (cell lines)
tableDetection.description: Keep 'Auto' unless you get extra small tables you do not need.

parseNumbers.title: Convert numbers
parseNumbers.description: Turn '1,234.50', '1.234,50', '$12.00' and '(15.00)' into numbers (decimal comma or point is detected per document), so they sum correctly in Excel. Percentages and codes with leading zeros stay as text.

dateOrder.title: Date order for dates like 03/04/2026
enumTitles: Auto (day first for 03.04.2026 and decimal-comma documents, month first for US 03/04/2026)
dateOrder.description: Invoice dates are returned as YYYY-MM-DD. Only matters when day and month are both 12 or less.

saveExcel.title: Save one Excel file for the run
saveExcel.description: Also saves OUTPUT.xlsx in the run's key-value store: a sheet with all invoice lines, a sheet with one row per invoice, and one sheet per table. The dataset itself can be exported to CSV, Excel or JSON as usual.

pdfPassword.title: PDF password
pdfPassword.description: Only for password-protected PDFs (the same password is tried on every file).

maxPagesPerDocument.title: Max pages per PDF
maxPagesPerDocument.description: Read only the first N pages of each PDF (0 = all pages).

maxDocuments.title: Max PDFs
maxDocuments.description: Maximum number of PDFs in one run.
